title: Coherent comparison with a family of row colimits
statement: Use the fixed universes, small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor categories, transformations, mapping spaces and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $I,J$ be small simplicial sets and $\mathcal E$ a quasicategory in a containing universe. Suppose given a coherent functor $L:\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal E)\to\mathcal E$ and a coherent transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to\Delta_J L$ such that, for each $A:J\to\mathcal E$, the cocone $\eta_A:A\to\Delta_J L(A)$ is colimiting. Let $R:I\to\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal E)$ and $U:I\to\mathcal E$ be coherent diagrams and let $\alpha:R\to\Delta_J\circ U$ be a coherent transformation. Assume that for every vertex $i\in I$ the cocone $\alpha_i:R(i)\to\Delta_J U(i)$ is colimiting. Then there is a coherent equivalence $a:LR\to U$ and a homotopy, in the entire coherent transformation space, between $\alpha$ and $(\Delta_J a)\circ(\eta R)$. More precisely, the space of pairs consisting of $a$ and such a compatibility homotopy is contractible, and every comparison in this space is a coherent equivalence. No colimits other than the displayed $J$-colimits are assumed, and neither index is required to be sifted or weakly contractible.

source.place: Agent-formulated coherent row-colimit comparison extracted from the successive-colimit reconstruction of HTT Proposition 5.5.8.6 (printed p.507), referring to the absolute case of Lemma 5.5.2.3 (printed pp.463-464). The PDF was read online; this precise cylinder/mapping-space formulation is not quoted as a theorem of HTT. No Stacks tag states the quasicategorical result.
